# ============================================================================
# AGENT CI/CD TEMPLATE
# ============================================================================
# Rename to: <agent>.yml (e.g., opena5.yml, opena6.yml, opena8.yml, etc)
#
# Usage: Replace these placeholders:
#   {{AGENT_NAME}}    -> opena5, opena6, opena7, etc
#   {{AGENT_NUM}}     -> 5, 6, 7, etc
#   {{AGENT_DIR}}     -> 4.opena5_vscode, 5.opena6_browser, 6.opena7_email, etc
#   {{AGENT_PORT}}    -> 12350, 12351, 12352, etc
#   {{AGENT_CATEGORY}} -> connector, email, browser, etc
# ============================================================================

name: {{AGENT_NAME}} CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
    paths:
      - '{{AGENT_DIR}}/**'
      - 'dist/{{AGENT_NAME}}/**'
      - '.github/workflows/{{AGENT_NAME}}.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - '{{AGENT_DIR}}/**'

concurrency:
  group: {{AGENT_NAME}}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  APP_DIR: {{AGENT_DIR}}
  DIST_DIR: dist/{{AGENT_NAME}}
  PORT: "{{AGENT_PORT}}"
  SERVICE_NAME: {{AGENT_NAME}}
  AGENT_CATEGORY: {{AGENT_CATEGORY}}
  REGISTRY: docker.io
  IMAGE_NAME: {{AGENT_NAME}}
  PYTHON_VERSION: "3.12"
  PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK: "1"

jobs:
  # ========================================
  # LINT & CODE QUALITY
  # ========================================
  lint:
    name: Code Quality (Pre-commit)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: pip

      - name: Install pre-commit
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pre-commit

      - name: Run pre-commit hooks
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          pre-commit run --all-files

  # ========================================
  # PYTHON SYNTAX & IMPORT CHECKS
  # ========================================
  python-check:
    name: Python Syntax & Imports
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: pip

      - name: Install requirements
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
        working-directory: ${{ env.APP_DIR }}

      - name: Check Python syntax (main.py)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m py_compile app/main.py
        working-directory: ${{ env.APP_DIR }}

      - name: Check imports
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -c "from app.main import app; print('✅ Imports OK')"
        working-directory: ${{ env.APP_DIR }}

  # ========================================
  # DOCKER BUILD & TEST
  # ========================================
  docker-build:
    name: Docker Build Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    needs: [ lint, python-check ]
    env:
      COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME: {{AGENT_NAME}}_ci
      DOCKER_BUILDKIT: "1"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Compose config validation
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd "${{ env.DIST_DIR }}"
          docker compose config >/dev/null

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd "${{ env.DIST_DIR }}"
          docker compose build --no-cache "${{ env.SERVICE_NAME }}"

      - name: Verify imports in container
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd "${{ env.DIST_DIR }}"
          IMAGE_ID="$(docker compose images -q "${{ env.SERVICE_NAME }}" | head -1)"
          test -n "$IMAGE_ID"
          docker run --rm "$IMAGE_ID" python -c "from app.main import app; print('✅ App imports OK')"

  # ========================================
  # API ENDPOINT TESTS
  # ========================================
  api-test:
    name: API Endpoint Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    needs: docker-build
    env:
      COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME: {{AGENT_NAME}}_ci
      DOCKER_BUILDKIT: "1"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Start {{AGENT_NAME}} container
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd "${{ env.DIST_DIR }}"
          docker compose up -d --build "${{ env.SERVICE_NAME }}"

      - name: Wait for health (polling, no sleep race)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for i in {1..40}; do
            if curl -fsS "http://localhost:${{ env.PORT }}/health" >/tmp/health.json 2>/dev/null; then
              cat /tmp/health.json
              echo "✅ Service is up"
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "Waiting... (${i}/40)"
            sleep 2
          done
          echo "❌ Service did not become healthy"
          cd "${{ env.DIST_DIR }}"
          docker compose logs --no-color "${{ env.SERVICE_NAME }}" | tail -200
          exit 1

      - name: Test /health endpoint
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          HEALTH="$(curl -fsS "http://localhost:${{ env.PORT }}/health")"
          echo "Health: $HEALTH"
          echo "$HEALTH" | grep -q "\"service\":\"${{ env.SERVICE_NAME }}\"" && echo "✅ Health OK"

      - name: Test /api/status
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          STATUS="$(curl -fsS "http://localhost:${{ env.PORT }}/api/status")"
          echo "Status: $STATUS"
          echo "$STATUS" | grep -q '"version"' && echo "✅ Status OK"

      - name: Test /api/info (dashboard integration)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          INFO="$(curl -fsS "http://localhost:${{ env.PORT }}/api/info")"
          echo "Info: $INFO"
          echo "$INFO" | grep -q '"display_name"' && echo "✅ Info OK"

      - name: Test root endpoint (HTML UI)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          HTML="$(curl -fsS "http://localhost:${{ env.PORT }}/")"
          echo "$HTML" | grep -qi '<title>.*{{AGENT_NAME}}' && echo "✅ HTML UI loaded"
          echo "$HTML" | grep -q '<button' && echo "✅ Buttons present"

      - name: Dump logs on failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd "${{ env.DIST_DIR }}"
          docker compose logs --no-color "${{ env.SERVICE_NAME }}" | tail -300

      - name: Cleanup containers
        if: always()
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd "${{ env.DIST_DIR }}"
          docker compose down -v

  # ========================================
  # SECURITY SCAN (Soft-fail)
  # ========================================
  security:
    name: Security Scan (Trivy)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Trivy filesystem scan
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.28.0
        with:
          scan-type: 'fs'
          scan-ref: '${{ env.APP_DIR }}'
          format: 'sarif'
          output: 'trivy-results.sarif'

      - name: Upload Trivy results
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
        if: always()
        with:
          sarif_file: 'trivy-results.sarif'

  # ========================================
  # CODE METRICS
  # ========================================
  metrics:
    name: Code Metrics
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Count lines of code
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "=== {{AGENT_NAME}} Code Metrics ==="
          echo "Main app:"
          wc -l "${{ env.APP_DIR }}/app/main.py" 2>/dev/null || echo "N/A"
          echo ""
          echo "HTML UI:"
          wc -l "${{ env.APP_DIR }}/app/html/index.html" 2>/dev/null || echo "N/A"
          echo ""
          echo "JavaScript:"
          wc -l "${{ env.APP_DIR }}/app/static/app.js" 2>/dev/null || echo "N/A"

  # ========================================
  # PUBLISH (main only)
  # ========================================
  publish:
    name: Build Docker Image (main only)
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    needs: [ lint, python-check, docker-build, api-test ]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Detect version
        id: version
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          VERSION="$(python3 - << 'PY'
          import re
          from pathlib import Path
          try:
              p = Path("${{ env.APP_DIR }}/app/main.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
              m = re.search(r'"version"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', p)
              if m:
                  print(m.group(1))
              else:
                  print("$(date +%Y.%m.%d)")
          except:
              print("$(date +%Y.%m.%d)")
          PY
          )"
          echo "VERSION=$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Detected version: $VERSION"

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build Docker image (production)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd "${{ env.DIST_DIR }}"
          docker build -t "${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ steps.version.outputs.VERSION }}" .
          docker tag "${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ steps.version.outputs.VERSION }}" "${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:latest"
          docker images "${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}"

  # ========================================
  # DEPLOYMENT READINESS
  # ========================================
  deploy-ready:
    name: Deployment Readiness
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    needs: [ lint, python-check, docker-build, api-test ]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate deployment report
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > /tmp/deployment_report.md << EOF
          ### 🚀 {{AGENT_NAME}} Deployment Readiness

          ✅ Code Quality: PASSED
          ✅ Docker Build: PASSED
          ✅ API Tests: PASSED

          **Configuration:**
          - Port: ${{ env.PORT }}
          - Category: ${{ env.AGENT_CATEGORY }}
          - Status: READY FOR PRODUCTION

          **Verified Endpoints:**
          - GET /health
          - GET /api/status
          - GET /api/info
          - GET / (UI)
          EOF
          cat /tmp/deployment_report.md

  # ========================================
  # SUMMARY
  # ========================================
  summary:
    name: CI Summary
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    needs: [ lint, python-check, docker-build, api-test, metrics ]
    steps:
      - name: Print summary
        run: |
          cat << 'EOF'
          ╔════════════════════════════════════════╗
          ║   {{AGENT_NAME}} CI/CD Pipeline        ║
          ╠════════════════════════════════════════╣
          ║ ✅ Lint & Code Quality                ║
          ║ ✅ Python Syntax Check                ║
          ║ ✅ Docker Build                       ║
          ║ ✅ API Endpoint Tests                 ║
          ║ ✅ Code Metrics                       ║
          ╚════════════════════════════════════════╝
          EOF
